## Bracketed life years

Display Chinese civil-year labels as `[1839]–[1890]`, using only resolved
`life.birth.chineseYear` / `life.death.chineseYear`. These denote Chinese-New-Year
intervals, not Gregorian calendar years. Display 享年 without 虛歲 commentary.
Keep source Gregorian dates separate and unbracketed; never infer a Chinese year
or exact age from a Gregorian year alone. Source quotations remain unchanged.

"Age at death": "享年",
  "Age at death: {age}": "享年 {age} 歲",
  "Gregorian": "公曆",
  "Source Gregorian years:": "文獻公曆：",
  "sui": "歲",

## Bracketed Chinese life years and 享年

In the interface, `[1811]` denotes the interval from the Chinese New Year in
1811 up to (but not including) the next Chinese New Year. A lifespan is displayed
as `[1811]–[1872]`, with **享年 62 歲**. The brackets belong to each year label,
not to a Gregorian lifespan range. Reign years and 干支 remain alongside it.
Only `life.birth.chineseYear` and `life.death.chineseYear` supply bracketed values;
unknown endpoints display `[?]`. Unresolved profiles may show separately labelled,
unbracketed Gregorian evidence. Source dates and quoted wording are never altered.
The timeline uses Chinese-year coordinates where resolved and labels any remaining
Gregorian evidence explicitly. Narrative-year anchors are not silently converted.
The ordinary UI says **享年** without an explanation of age reckoning.

expect(page.locator('#reader-biography .person-ad')).to_have_text('[1811]–[1872]')
        expect(page.locator('#reader-biography .person-sui')).to_have_text('享年 62 歲')
        report['bracketedChineseLifeYears']=True
        expect(page.locator('#entity-card')).to_contain_text('[1811]–[1872]')
        expect(page.locator('#entity-card')).to_contain_text('享年 62 歲')
        expect(page.locator('#profile .person-ad')).to_have_text('[1811]–[1872]')
        expect(page.locator('#profile .life-grid')).to_contain_text('享年')
        assert '虛歲' not in page.locator('#profile .life-grid').inner_text()
        assert 'sui' not in page.locator('#profile .life-grid').inner_text()
        assert '中曆卒年' not in page.locator('#profile .life-grid').inner_text()
